dedupe_keys.name: fcc post incentive auction tv coverage baseline full power and class a stations

description: This dataset gives the baseline coverage area and population of every US full-power and Class A television station on the channel it was assigned after the 2016-2017 broadcast incentive auction, which repacked TV stations into a smaller band to free spectrum for mobile broadband. For each of the 2,050 station facilities it lists call sign, facility id, city and state, channel and type, and the area and population within the noise-limited contour, within terrain-limited coverage and free of interference, computed with the FCC's TVStudy software (version 1.3.2) on the October 2015 database and study template. Coverage: the United States, station level, final channel assignments as published in June 2017. Format and access: a table through the Socrata API with CSV export, free as US government data. Caveats: a planning baseline, not measured coverage; later station changes are not reflected; population figures are from the model's census base. Simulation uses: service areas and population reached by broadcast television, used for emergency alerting reach, hazard exposure of transmitters and resilience of broadcast services. Related records: the Linked Station Neighbors table on the same portal gives repack coordination, and the FCC antenna structure registration gives towers.
